subject: [RFC PATCH 03/18] fuse: don't move a folio with PG_rcu_free into a fuse file

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch prevents a folio marked for RCU freeing from being moved into a fuse file, which can lead to unexpected behavior when the folio is still being copied by a lockless page cache read. The issue arises when a mapped file page is gifted with vmsplice(SPLICE_F_GIFT) and its file is then truncated. Instead of moving the folio, the patch copies it as fuse does in similar situations.
